INDEPENDENT PORTFOLIO PROJECT

A small tool.
A practical purpose.

AI-assisted job coordination for the businesses across digital, creative, administrative and physical services.

THE BUSINESS CASE

Make the next service call easier to organise.

A fictional pool contractor receives a message about weak circulation and dirt returning after a backwash. Before scheduling work, they need to ask the right questions, prepare tools and explain what happens next. FieldBrief turns that request into a reviewable job brief and a transparent estimate structure.

This is a working independent demo. All example requests are fictional. No previous client, measured time saving or revenue outcome is claimed.

Try the pool filter example ↗
WHAT IT DOES

From intake to a clear reply.

  • Text input, nine sample requests across digital and physical services and optional local reference photos.
  • Transparent rule-based triage: category, provisional problem, urgency, materials, questions and next steps.
  • Editable labour, parts, call-out and tax calculations in EUR, USD or GBP.
  • Optional real on-device AI generates an alternative assessment and customer reply.
  • Editable/copyable replies, structured JSON download and print/save as PDF.
TECHNICAL APPROACH

Lean by design.

JavaScript ES modulesHTML + CSSWeb WorkerTransformers.jsQwen2.5 / ONNXNode test runner

A static web app with no database, paid inference API or secret keys. AI model files are downloaded from Hugging Face when requested, and inference runs locally in the browser. Customer request text and photos are not sent to a cloud AI endpoint. Google Fonts and CDN/model downloads make normal network requests.

The model download is substantial (roughly 400 MB plus runtime assets). AI quality and mobile memory support vary. The core brief remains usable if AI cannot load. A qualified professional must check urgency, diagnosis, scope and prices.

A FOCUSED FIRST ENGAGEMENT

Adapt one workflow. Prove it end to end.

A sensible paid extension could be a branded intake form, an agreed output schema and one destination such as a spreadsheet or an email draft. Define acceptance criteria, review example cases, test failures and hand over documented source. CRM, WhatsApp and scheduled workflows are possible future integrations, not features claimed by this prototype.
